description.value: The Fort Street Keg is a full-service steakhouse and bar occupying an 1863 Heritage Building at the corner of Fort and Wharf Streets in downtown Victoria, with views of the harbour. It is one of The Keg's original locations and has been in continuous operation since 1972, making it a Victoria landmark. Touring cyclists finishing a day on the Galloping Goose or Lochside trails will find it a short ride from the waterfront in the heart of the downtown core.
